name: ethanolamine kinase 1

function.text: ETNK1 encodes ethanolamine kinase 1. Annotated molecular activities include ethanolamine kinase activity. It participates in phosphatidylethanolamine biosynthetic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include MDS/MPN with neutrophilia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
